title: SG-1.2 · Create the Zustand UI store for drawer, modal, sound and settings
summary: Add a Zustand UI store in game/frontend/src that components can import.
description: Context: game/frontend has no Zustand dependency and no store. GameLayout keeps drawerOpen in local useState. Desired behavior: a single importable store holds drawer, modal, sound and settings flags with actions such as toggleDrawer. Expected result: components can import useUiStore from game/frontend/src/store/uiStore.ts. Why: the shell needs shared UI state without prop drilling.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frontend module, When a component imports useUiStore from src/store/uiStore, Then it resolves and type-checks
Given the store, When toggleDrawer is called, Then drawerOpen flips between false and true

out_of_scope: Rewiring GameLayout or HeaderOverlay to the store

technical_constraints: Zustand is the mandated state library
definition_of_done: Store file exists and is importable
